class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/DummyEvaluator
class.description: A "dummy" implementation for RecoveryEvaluatorBase. Always reports OK. This evaluator does nothing. It serves as an example and a reference plugin.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/DummyMitigation
class.description: A "dummy" implementation for RecoveryMitigationBase. Accepts any non-OK diagnostic and immediately reports SUCCEEDED. Serves as an example and a reference plugin.

class.name: easynav_diagnostic_recovery/DummySafetyReflex
class.description: A "dummy" implementation for SafetyReflexBase. Never intervenes unless its "trigger" parameter is true, then stops the robot. Serves as an example and a reference plugin.
